title: Upward acceleration calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates upward acceleration using v₀²=2a_upL with v₀=√15 m/s and L=0.5 m.

title: Downward acceleration calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates downward acceleration using v²=2a_downL with v=√5 m/s and L=0.5 m.

title: Acceleration ratio
description: Essential: Correctly computes a_up/a_down = 3 as the final answer for part (1).

title: Base fall time
description: Important: Calculates time for base to fall distance H=0.2 m using H=½gt₁².

title: Ring motion after base stops
description: Important: Sets up equation L=v₁t₂+½a₂t₂² for ring's motion after base hits ground, with correct a₂.

title: Total collision time
description: Essential: Correctly sums t₁+t₂ to get 0.4 s as final answer for part (2).

title: Rebound velocity calculation
description: Important: Correctly computes base's rebound velocity as (3/4) of impact speed after free fall.

title: Velocity equality setup
description: Important: Sets up equation v_ring - a_up t = v_base - g t to find when velocities match.

title: Time for equal velocities
description: Essential: Correctly solves for t=0.1 s as final answer for part (3) time.

title: Relative distance calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes relative displacement difference to get 0.025 m as final answer for part (3) distance.

title: Sign error in accelerations
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign convention for accelerations in kinematic equations (e.g., treating upward acceleration as positive when it should be negative relative to chosen coordinate system).

title: Confusing acceleration values
description: Pitfall: Uses a_up=15 m/s² or a_down=5 m/s² directly without dividing by L, or confuses which is which.

title: Incorrect rebound speed
description: Pitfall: Uses √5 m/s directly as ring's initial speed in part (3) instead of deriving it from the given conditions.
